title: Require Service Module Isolation
forbids: any service-root production file outside modules importing module source except contract-to-contract, router-to-router, or base type-only model/ports declaration; any relative source entering an exact modules segment at any depth outside those root exceptions; service-root module re-exports; module parent traversal outside exact authorship and anchor edges; raw base acquisition outside module middleware; impl acquisition outside module.ts or unconfigured owning-router middleware authorship; a module router index acquiring an implementer or middleware catalog; or a standalone module entering a sibling through its current-owner private alias
why: Service roots compose module contracts and operation trees, while modules retain their own execution, model, and policy authority. The only root model edge is a type-only host-bound module port declared by base context. The database blueprint independently owns database placement and imports.
remediate: Keep every root module import to contract composition, operation-tree composition, or a type-only model/ports edge from base.ts. Do not disguise another module edge inside a deeper relative path. Import base from module middleware for context-only capability authoring; import impl from module middleware for unconfigured router-descendant policy authorship rooted at impl.<module> and from module.ts for configured descent. Router leaves may use ../module and the one exact ../middleware catalog edge; keep router/index.ts a plain module tree without either implementer or middleware acquisition. Remove root execution imports, policy edges, other parent traversal, sibling entry, and root module re-exports.
message: Service roots compose modules; modules own their implementation and do not enter siblings.
